perplexity.description:
Metal Killers is a 1984 heavy metal compilation album released by the UK-based Kastle Killers label. The album features a selection of tracks from prominent hard rock and heavy metal acts of the era, including Black Sabbath, Twisted Sister, Judas Priest, Diamond Head, and UFO. Musically, the compilation showcases the diversity of the genre in the early 1980s, blending classic heavy metal with elements of the New Wave of British Heavy Metal (NWOBHM) and hard rock, reflecting the energy and stylistic range that defined the period.

As part of Kastle Killers' early output, Metal Killers stands as a notable entry in the label's discography, helping to introduce American and British metal to a wider audience. The album was followed by a sequel, Metal Killers II, also released in 1984, further cementing the label's role in curating metal anthologies. While there is limited documentation of its commercial performance or critical reception at the time, the compilation remains a valued collector's item among fans of vintage heavy metal and is recognized for capturing the spirit of the genre during a pivotal era.
